description: A C# implementation of the XxHash32 non-cryptographic hashing algorithm, providing hash computation functionalities with support for optional seeds, incremental hashing, and external data references.

classes.name: XxHash32
classes.description: Provides an implementation of the XxHash32 algorithm with support for incremental hash computation and seed customization.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the hash computation to the initial state.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends data to the current hash computation.

methods.name: GetCurrentHashCore
methods.description: Computes the current hash value without altering the state.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Computes the XxHash32 hash of the provided byte array or span.

methods.name: TryHash
methods.description: Attempts to compute the hash into a provided buffer.
